# Emitter operates on Knowledge IR only

Emitters must render publications/embeddings from Knowledge IR only; the emit method accepts Entities, Relationships and a Delta and produces publications (docstring/pipeline reference).

Ensure publication rendering is performed from compiled knowledge representations rather than from raw artifacts or other inputs.

- `knowledge_compiler/interfaces.py` — `knowledge_compiler.interfaces.Emitter.emit`
